summary: Minimal, correct fix: guards the deprecation warning and the categorical-units info log behind a non-empty size check, so empty arrays (where `all(...)` vacuously returns True) no longer trigger a spurious MatplotlibDeprecationWarning/ConversionError. Both `values` and `data` are numpy arrays in these methods, so `.size` is safe.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining that the `.size` guard exists to suppress the vacuous-true `all()` result on empty input; future readers may not see why the check was added.
